title: Abaqaphi Bengadi
intro: Engadini evundile, umphakathi wenza isifungo esiqinile. Kodwa ukuzimisela kwawo kwavivinywa lapho intando kaNkulunkulu ingenelela, iguqula inala yawo yaba izwe elingenalutho.
clues: Sabusiswa ngensimu eningi, kodwa saba ngabaqhoshayo.
Senze uhlelo lokuvuna ngaphandle kokwabelana nabampofu.
Saqala ekuseni kakhulu, siqiniseka ngecebo lethu.
Kodwa lapho sifika, sathola ukuthi ingadi yethu yayibhujiswe ngobusuku obubodwa.
Saqaphela iphutha lethu futhi saqala ukusolana.
Ekugcineni saphenduka, kodwa isifundo safundwa sekwephuzile.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
